title: Two different `near` CLIs exist; the Node one is installed
summary: The older Node `near-cli` and the Rust `near-cli-rs` have different command sets, and tutorials mix them. The near-cli-rs site describes itself as the recommended CLI for new users.
message: The `near` on PATH is the Node near-cli {version}.

steps: Know which CLI you are using before following a tutorial: this one is the Node `near-cli`.
near-cli-rs is described as the recommended CLI for new users at https://near.cli.rs.

evidence.observed: Observed 2026-11-13: `npm i -g near-cli` printed about 15 deprecation warnings (@ledgerhq/*, prebuild-install, base-x) and `near --version` printed 4.0.13; near.cli.rs says near-cli-rs is recommended.
